title: Traffic Redirection Attack (ProxyBot)
summary: As documented, tool calls including fund transfers are rerouted through an attacker's endpoint.

LC.rationale: In the default simulated configuration no model is called and ProxyBot is an MCP tool server that resolves any tool name and returns scripted results; no natural-language path reaches a security-relevant sink.

CP.rationale: ProxyBot keeps no memory; the lab profile states cross-session persistence exists only in MemoryBot, and ProxyBot's scripted results are not stored.

AP.rationale: The effect is confined to the ProxyBot MCP server; the documented redirect chain is not implemented by default and no handoff to another agent occurs.

RH.rationale: No evaluator, verifier or reward channel is on the path; transfer_funds returns a scripted result and no proxy connection is made, so there is nothing to reach.

ES.rationale: ProxyBot resolves any tool name with no authentication and no argument schema or credential constraint, which is a dynamic, unvetted extension surface.

agentic_applicability.rationale: scored as modeled; default config is scripted. The lab models ProxyBot as an MCP tool server that accepts any tool name and returns scripted results labeled as proxied, with no model in the loop.
